title: Wolfspeed, Inc. Announces Date of Fiscal First Quarter Earnings Call for November 4, 2026 | Wolfspeed
summary: Wolfspeed, Inc. will conduct a conference call and audio webcast to discuss its first quarter fiscal 2027 results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 5:00 pm Eastern Time.
body_markdown:
**DURHAM, N.C.** **–** October 15, 2026–Wolfspeed, Inc. (NYSE: WOLF), a global leader in silicon carbide technology, will conduct a conference call and audio webcast to discuss its first quarter fiscal 2027 results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 5:00 pm Eastern Time. The call will be hosted by Robert Feurle, Chief Executive Officer, and Gregor van Issum, Chief Financial Officer.


A live webcast of the earnings conference call along with the earnings release will be available on Wolfspeed’s Investor Relations website at[https://investor.wolfspeed.com](https://investor.wolfspeed.com/) .


**About Wolfspeed, Inc.**


Wolfspeed (NYSE: WOLF) leads the market in the worldwide adoption of silicon carbide technologies that power some of the world’s most disruptive innovations. As pioneers of silicon carbide, and creators of an advanced semiconductor technology, we are committed to powering a better world for everyone. Through silicon carbide material, Power Modules, Discrete Power Devices and Power Die Products targeted for various applications, we will bring you The Power to Make It RealTM. Learn more at[www.wolfspeed.com](https://www.wolfspeed.com/) .
